description: Creates a new custom OAuth scope for an application. You must specify the Id of the application you are creating the scope for. You can optionally specify an Id for the OAuth scope on the URL, if not provided one will be generated.

X-FusionAuth-TenantId.description: The unique Id of the tenant used to scope this API request. Only required when there is more than one tenant and the API key is not tenant-scoped.

applicationId.description: The Id of the application to create the OAuth scope on.

requestBody.description: The Application Scope API request object.

scope.description: A custom OAuth scope for a specific application.

insertInstant.description: The number of milliseconds since the unix epoch: January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC. This value is always in UTC.

lastUpdateInstant.description: The number of milliseconds since the unix epoch: January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC. This value is always in UTC.

scopeId.description: The Id of the OAuth scope. If not provided a secure random UUID will be generated.

name: createOAuthScopeWithId
